title: English Teacher – IBDP, Aug 1st 2026 – Brasilia, Brazil
description:
Overview

Secondary English Teacher required for a British International school in Brazil.

The School

The school offers British International education to pupils in EYFS, Primary and Secondary School up to Year 13. The school is located in an exclusive district of Brasilia and enjoys a spacious, green, clean-air environment. Since opening in 2016, the school has established itself as the school of choice for many expatriate and Brazilian parents seeking an international education in Brasilia. The core of our curriculum is British, with a distinct international flavour. The staff have experience of working both in the UK and abroad and are drawn from a range of countries and cultures.

The Role

The successful candidate will teach IB Diploma Programme English (Language & Literature and/or Literature), delivering high-quality lessons in line with IB standards and assessment criteria. You will play a key role in preparing students for internal assessments, oral assessments, coursework, and external examinations, ensuring accurate marking and moderation. You will foster independent learning, critical thinking, and advanced academic writing skills, while supporting students with Extended Essays and contributing to the wider IB ethos, including links to Theory of Knowledge (TOK) where appropriate.

The Ideal Candidate

We are seeking an outstanding practitioner who:

  • Holds a recognised teaching qualification (QTS or equivalent)
  • Has UK or international secondary teaching experience
  • Has proven experience teaching the IB Diploma English Programme
  • Demonstrates strong subject knowledge and a clear understanding of IB assessment and philosophy
  • Has experience preparing students for coursework, oral assessments, and external examinations
  • Is reflective, well organised, and committed to continuous professional development
  • Communicates effectively and works collaboratively within a high-performing team

Pastoral and Professional Contribution

At BSB, IB teachers play a vital role in both academic and pastoral life. You will mentor students, promote their wellbeing, participate in IB training and standardisation, and uphold the school’s behaviour and safeguarding policies consistently. You will also contribute to curriculum development, professional dialogue, and wider school activities.

To find out more

Please contact Rowan O’Hara at to discuss the role, school and location.

About ANZUK Education

ANZUK Education has supported educators since 2004. We’re able to fully support schools and educators by finding the right educator, right place, right time. Our International Schools Team is dedicated to ensuring equity in education for students by connecting great teachers to schools that truly value them.

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you’ll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high‑quality results. In this role, you won’t just review what AI produces — you’ll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real‑world application.

Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human‑AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

Typical tasks

  • Deliver well‑reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher‑quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.
  • Adapt quickly between diverse annotation, research, and analysis tasks while following detailed guidelines.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled in or have completed a Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in any field.
  • You have professional and/or educational experience in data annotation, demonstrate a deeper‑than‑user‑level interest in AI, and possess intellectual breadth and curiosity.
  • You are skilled in web searching, fact‑checking, intent‑checking, able to work with LLMs and have great attention to detail.
  • Your level of English is upper‑intermediate (B2) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $9/hour depending on your skills, experience, location and project needs.
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Are you ready to redefine what "safety" means on the road? We are looking for a Superstar Senior Product Owner based in Brazil to lead the charge for our North American Video Safety portfolio.

This isn't a "business as usual" role. You will be the bridge between high-level strategic vision and ground-level engineering execution, driving the evolution of our cutting-edge AI video solutions. If you thrive in the intersection of deep technical execution and strategic market alignment, we want to talk to you.

The Mission

As our Senior PO, you will be the heartbeat of our Video Safety engineering squads in Latin America. Your primary focus is the North American Market. You will translate complex market needs into a high-velocity execution engine, ensuring our video portals, AI event detection, and driver coaching tools remain the gold standard for our customers.

What You’ll Own

  • Execution Excellence: Take the North American product roadmap and turn it into reality. You’ll be embedded with multiple engineering teams, managing the backlog for our Video Safety Portal, Front-end solutions, and AI-driven behavior events.
  • Strategic Connectivity: Partner closely with our Product Managers, Product Marketing, Sales, and Engineering to digest company-wide goals and synthesize them into actionable technical requirements.
  • Customer Advocacy: This isn't a "behind the desk" job. You will get deep into the weeds of our North American customers' needs, understanding their pain points to ensure the "why" is communicated as clearly as the "what."
  • The AI Frontier: Lead the development of our Video Driver Behavior and Event AI solutions, ensuring our coaching and performance and reporting capabilities empower fleets to save lives and reduce risk.

Who You Are

  • A Senior Leader: Reporting to the Director of Product, you are a high-impact contributor who can master complex technical landscapes quickly and hit the ground running to drive high-stakes products with minimal hand-holding.
  • A Master Communicator: You can explain the nuances of the North American market to LatAm engineering teams and vice versa, ensuring nothing is lost in translation.
  • Technical & Analytical: You are comfortable discussing the nuances of AI models and the logic behind video event detection. Simultaneously, you must be capable of shifting context to discuss front-end UX flows and the user experience.
  • Relentless Driver: You are obsessed with delivery. You know how to unblock teams, prioritize effectively, and keep the momentum high.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in SaaS, Telematics, or Video/AI tech. You have a proven ability to leverage AI tools across all aspects of your role—from automating documentation to accelerating product discovery—to drive both personal productivity and product innovation. Expert-level familiarity with Atlassian (Jira, Confluence) and Google Suite is required.
  • Market Context: Deep familiarity with the North American market (its standards, customer expectations, and regulatory environment) is a non-negotiable requirement.
  • Leadership: Experience working with distributed engineering teams in Latin America and across other global regions.
  • Fluency: Professional-level English is required for strategic alignment and customer interaction.

Why Join Us?

We are building the future of road safety. This role offers the unique opportunity to work on high-visibility AI projects that have a direct impact on human lives. You’ll have the autonomy to make real decisions and the support of a global team that is as ambitious as you are.

title: Human UP em Juiz de Fora
description:
Overview

Evento Human UP será realizado no Moinho Juiz de Fora. Nos dias 22 e 23 de outubro, o Moinho realiza e recebe a primeira edição do Human UP – Liderança que inspira, inova e transforma, um evento imersivo criado para quem acredita no poder das lideranças conscientes e na força estratégica da gestão de pessoas.

Em um mundo em constante transformação, o Human UP será o ponto de encontro de líderes, gestores, empresários e especialistas em desenvolvimento humano que desejam repensar suas práticas, explorar novas possibilidades e criar organizações mais humanas, inovadoras e sustentáveis.

O Human UP será realizado no Moinho, um espaço com fácil acesso, estacionamento, áreas de alimentação próximas e uma estrutura pensada para receber eventos, na Av. Presidente Juscelino Kubitschek, 900, Francisco Bernardino, Juiz de Fora - MG

Para quem é o Human UP?

  • Líderes e gestores que desejam se atualizar
  • Profissionais que atuam como agentes de transformação
  • Empresários e executivos C-Level
  • Gestores de RH e desenvolvimento humano
  • Profissionais de cultura e estratégia

Conteúdo de alto impacto: tendências, estratégias e cases que vão transformar a forma de pensar liderança e gestão de pessoas. Palestrantes referência no Brasil e exterior: especialistas que abordam felicidade corporativa, RH estratégico, inteligência emocional na era da IA e liderança que equilibra performance e bem-estar. Workshops provocadores: experiências hands-on para aplicar novos conceitos na rotina de gestão. Feira de Negócios com expositores estratégicos: soluções, ferramentas e tecnologias para impulsionar resultados. Conexões com grandes lideranças da região: networking qualificado com gestores e profissionais influentes da Zona da Mata, Campo das Vertentes e Centro-Sul Fluminense.

Temas e palestrantes confirmados

  • “Felicidade Corporativa: Construindo Culturas de Bem-Estar que Impulsionam os Negócios” — Renata Rivetti. Especialista em Felicidade Corporativa, TEDx Speaker e LinkedIn Top Voice. Referência em Psicologia Positiva, com formações em Harvard, Penn e Berkeley, leva sua expertise para transformar empresas em espaços onde bem-estar e performance caminham juntos.
  • “Inteligência Emocional na Era da Inteligência Artificial: O Medo do Futuro do Trabalho e o Foco nas Pessoas” — Salim Khouri. Diretor de Talentos & Cultura Brasil e Head Global de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão da Syngenta. Executivo premiado, já reconhecido entre os líderes de RH mais admirados, traz reflexões sobre como equilibrar tecnologia e humanidade na construção do futuro do trabalho.
  • “O RH como Protagonista da Transformação” — Genesson Honorato. Psicólogo, consultor em inovação e diversidade, TEDx Speaker e LinkedIn Top Voice. Professor convidado da Fundação Dom Cabral e membro de conselhos de inovação, é considerado um dos nomes mais influentes do RH no Brasil, mostrando como a área pode liderar mudanças culturais e estratégicas.
  • “Da Cultura à Operação: Liderança que Entrega” — Jayme Nigri Moszkowicz. Cofundador da Reserva e atual CEO da Rebels Ventures. Conduziu a fusão com a Arezzo&Co, que deu origem à AR&Co. Hoje, à frente da Rebels Ventures, acelera negócios de bem-estar e prepara novos líderes, sendo referência em gestão humanizada e liderança transformadora.

Workshop e painel com talentos locais

O Human UP também contará com espaços de aprofundamento e troca prática. O workshop “NR-1 Atualizada – Do Diagnóstico à Ação: Gestão de Riscos Psicossociais em Ambientes de Trabalho”, coordenado pela Em Dia Saúde e Bem-Estar, vai discutir como empresas podem implementar políticas de saúde ocupacional que respondam às novas exigências legais e, ao mesmo tempo, promovam ambientes mais seguros e saudáveis.

Já o painel “Comunicação Assertiva como Pilar da Liderança Transformadora” reunirá nomes de destaque do ecossistema regional, trazendo uma perspectiva prática e próxima da realidade das empresas.

A mediação será de Luana Lourençon, mentora e coach de carreira, especialista em comunicação para líderes e LinkedIn Top Voice. O debate contará com a participação de Diogo Souza Gomes, CEO da Souza Gomes Imóveis, e Bruno Imbrizi, fundador e CEO da Chico Rei e da Uma Penca, que vão compartilhar suas experiências em como engajar equipes, fortalecer culturas organizacionais e gerar resultados sustentáveis

Natural de Juiz de Fora, jornalista com graduação e mestrado pela Faculdade de Comunicação da Universidade Federal de Juiz de Fora (UFJF). Experiência anterior em Rádio, TV e Internet. Gosta de esporte, filmes e livros. Editora Web na Itatiaia Juiz de Fora desde 2023. Tricampeã na categoria Web/Mídias Digitais no Prêmio Oddone Prêmio Oddone Turolla de Jornalismo, do Sindicomércio JF.

Overview :

We are looking for a highly experienced Edge Network Engineer to lead complex edge, network, and cloud platform deployments. This role will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert during onboarding, migrations, and new platform integrations. Success in this role requires exceptional technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead both technical workstreams and customer expectations.

The Edge Network Engineer position provides customer facing network design, implementation, configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocols, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, this role also serves as a Tier 4 escalation point from the global support organization.

Experience with SD-WAN—especially Versa Networks—is a major asset and will elevate your candidacy.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Lead customer deployments of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration, and SD-WAN platforms.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for end-to-end implementation activities, including architecture planning, configuration, testing, and go-live support.
  • Work closely with project managers, systems engineers, and customer stakeholders to align on design and timelines.
  • Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, and networks.
  • Develop automation scripts and reusable tooling to improve speed and consistency of deployments within the larger context of the company strategy.
  • Document procedures, configurations, and lessons learned; contribute to internal knowledge bases.
  • Mentor junior engineers and participate in internal enablement and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Participate in periodic customer workshops to review implementation design as needed to support large-scale or complex rollouts.

Qualifications :

  • Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies; experience with lightweight Kubernetes distributions (e.g., K3s) preferred.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DNS, NAT, Routing protocols and proxies.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing network interfaces, both physical and virtual.
  • Prior experience with SD-WAN deployment and management; Versa SD-WAN experience is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in using tools such astcpdump, Wireshark,iptables,netstat, and other network diagnostic utilities.
  • Experience with cloud service providers such as Azure or AWS, including VM provisioning, datastore configuration, and SSO setup.
  • Comfortable working with REST APIs and using tools like Postman, Swagger, curl, and Python scripts for automation and testing.
  • Awareness of secure deployment principles; familiarity with TPM, encryption, and measured boot is a plus (can be trained internally).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bash scripting.
  • Experience with tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM platforms for Project/Change/Incident management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document issues, escalate appropriately, and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Background :

  • 5+ years in edge infrastructure deployment, implementation engineering, or similar technical field.
  • Experience supporting or deploying edge orchestration platforms (e.g., Zededa, Azure IoT Edge, AWS Greengrass).
  • Experience with zero-touch provisioning, telemetry pipelines, or site/network architecture at the edge is a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Work at the cutting edge of network operations, edge computing/networking, and satellite systems, enabling global connectivity in the most remote and demanding scenarios.
  • Be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team that values technical depth, mentorship, and continuous learning.

Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you’re in the right place.

We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. Aqui no Sesc em Minas, acreditamos que a valorização das pessoas é a base para a verdadeira transformação social. Para assegurar nosso propósito, estamos em busca de profissionais que desejam contribuir para o bem-estar e a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos comerciários e da comunidade.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como MÉDICO(A) OTORRINOLARINGOLOGISTA na nossa unidade em Belo Horizonte/MG.

  • Atendimento aos pacientes conforme disponibilidade de agenda, por meio da realização de anamnese, exames físicos e complementares para diagnosticar condições relacionadas a ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e estruturas relacionadas, e traçar plano terapêutico individualizado, com a identificação dos riscos e benefícios do tratamento proposto;
  • Diagnosticar e tratar doenças do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço. Incluem desde infecções agudas até condições mais complexas como tumores, além de distúrbios da voz, audição e sono;
  • Orientar os pacientes sobre os fatores de risco para doenças do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço, nas consultas de rotinas, fornecendo orientações sobre hábitos de vida saudáveis para prevenção de doenças;
  • Monitorar a evolução das condições do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço, ajustar tratamentos, por meio do acompanhamento dos pacientes em consultas periódicas, conforme necessário para garantir a saúde do indivíduo a longo prazo;
  • Acompanhar os contratos como Fiscal ou Gestor, se indicado pela liderança, assegurando o cumprimento eficaz dos termos e condições contratuais, garantindo que ambas as partes, contratante e contratada, estejam aderentes às obrigações acordadas, além de garantir a conformidade com as regulamentações e políticas internas, inclusive no que se refere à transparência e prestação de contas, entre outras atividades.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica em Otorrinolaringologia ou Especialização Completa em Otorrinolaringologia, com Registro de Qualificação de Especialista (RQE) em Otorrinolaringologia.
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar numa carga horária de 20 horas semanais.

Realizar atendimentos pediátricos e procedimentos ambulatoriais.

  • Seguro de vida;

  • Vale-refeição ou vale alimentação (sem suspenção no período de férias ou licença maternidade).

  • Day off: uma folga no mês do seu aniversário para você curtir o seu dia como quiser.
  • Universidade Sesc: plataforma corporativa de aprendizado contínuo com treinamentos especiais para todos os empregados.

The Junior Accounting Analyst will play a key role in the accounting department, assisting with daily accounting activities and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data. The analyst will be responsible for supporting various accounting functions, including journal entries, reconciliations, and assisting with month-end closing processes. This role provides an excellent opportunity to learn and develop a strong foundation in accounting principles. The Junior Accounting Analyst will report to the Accounting Manager.

Responsibilities

Journal Entries:

  • Assist in making journal entries in financial and accounting systems, ensuring transactions are correctly classified and recorded.
  • Record routine operations such as payments, receipts, billing, and payroll, among others.
  • Perform bank reconciliations, and reconcile accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Identify and investigate potential discrepancies, and accurately and timely reconcile balances.

Account Analysis and Variance Analysis:

  • Analyze accounting accounts, identifying variations, trends, and anomalies in balances.
  • Prepare account analysis reports and explain variances to the accounting team.
  • Assist in preparing periodic financial reports, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
  • Collect and organize financial data to support management's decision-making.

Compliance with Tax and Regulatory Requirements:

  • Assist in preparing the necessary documentation and information to meet tax obligations, including tax returns and ancillary obligations.
  • Stay up-to-date with accounting and tax regulations, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and laws.

Support for Audits and Closing Processes:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing requested documentation and information accurately and on time.
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting close processes, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of accounting records.

Qualifications

  • Technical or bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Basic knowledge of financial accounting and accounting principles.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems and the Office suite, especially Excel.
  • Analytical skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication

title: Lifesharing Coordinator, ID/A Program
description:
Access Services is looking to welcome a Coordinator to our Lifesharing program team. The home base for this role is at our main office in Bethlehem, PA and requires regular travel in Lehigh, Northampton, and CMP counties.

You will be part of a team working to support adults with intellectual disabilities/Autism who live in our Lifesharing provider host homes. Our team works with the provider families and the individuals to ensure the home meets the needs and preferences of the person served. As a Coordinator, you will meet to review and update the individual's support plans, support the families and supervise the staff, which helps the individuals we serve attain their goals and live their best lives.

A Successful Lifesharing Coordinator Will

  • Be organized, detail-oriented, and have a willingness to learn the tech skills needed to use the systems we work in.
  • Be independent and confident in their ability to manage their cases, while being a team player and collaborating with the other coordinators in the department.
  • Be a responsible, out-of-the-box thinker who cares for the well-being of the people we serve and is willing to learn and advocate for them.
  • Maintain the individual's placement in their provider home.
  • Manage all relationships related to the case and exhibit emotional intelligence while working with the provider's different communication and emotional styles.
  • Care about people while also strongly prioritizing accuracy and details.
  • Have crisis management skills and patience.

A week in the life of a Lifesharing Coordinator might look like:

  • Being willing to step into the needs of the current day, as every day can look unique.
  • Weekly meetings with the Lifesharing department.
  • Meetings with the individual's team, their provider family, and county support coordinators.
  • Monitoring in the Lifesharing provider's home.
  • Managing the individual's medical care.
  • Prioritizing the volume of paperwork that is required with regulations and deadlines in mind.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist individuals in choosing a Lifesharing provider home that meets their individual needs and preferences.
  • Work as a team to help individuals develop their own individualized program plan.
  • Coordinate all supports outlined in the individual program plan.
  • Assist individuals in adjusting to their new homes, working through family conflicts, and becoming connected to their local communities.
  • Help ensure the safety of individuals through monitoring, maintenance, and implementation of all compliance and regulations.
  • Supervision of support staff.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university plus two years of work experience working directly with persons with intellectual disabilities / autism (ID/A).
  • OR An Associate's degree or 60 credit hours plus four years of work experience working directly with persons with ID/A.
  • OR A high school diploma plus six years of work experience working directly with persons with ID/A required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to effectively interact with all levels of staff, county and state officials, individuals, their families, and the general public.
  • Knowledge of principles and methods of habilitation.
  • Knowledge of behavior management, safety techniques and program planning principles.
  • Knowledge of basic concepts in family therapy and group work.
  • Knowledge of person-centered planning and the ability to help individuals meet their plan objectives.
  • Knowledge of disbursements of medications according to state licensing regulations. Knowledge of pertinent community resources and facilities.
  • First Aid and CPR certification required in this position. Access Services will provide the needed training and certification.

Essential Working Conditions/Physical Demands

  • Work in program sites, offsite locations, and the community routinely providing direct care and/or support with individual(s).
  • Stand, sit or run by self, or to provide proper care and supervision with an individual.
  • Able to move and stay with an individual to keep them safe, both in home environment and community, even when an individual may struggle to meet identified expectations.
  • Able to assist an individual who has fallen, regardless of weight or size.
  • Utilize desktop computer equipment daily and ability to lift or move items associated with sedentary work and light work (exert up to 20 lbs.).
  • Proficiency in, or ability to learn and use, workplace applications, platforms and technologies.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Starting at $20.75/hour, with adjustments made for education and experience; plus a competitive benefits package.
  • Work Schedule: Monday through Friday 9:00AM-5:00PM, flexibility with schedule and on-call rotation required. The location rotates from the Bethlehem office to the locations of the homes we serve in the Lehigh Valley.

Our Full-time Comprehensive Benefits Package Includes

  • Health, vision, Rx, and dental insurance with options for HSA/FSA.
  • Mileage reimbursement and paid travel time between worksites.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Referral bonuses.
  • 401k match.
  • Tuition reimbursement and college tuition discounts.
  • 20 days paid off plus additional time with continued service. Paid holiday time. Catastrophic sick leave.
  • Company paid Life Insurance as well as Long and Short-Term Disability.
  • Ongoing professional development training.
  • Discounts on various services. Perks with local credit unions.

  • Atualizar cadastros técnicos em sistemas como o SAP.
  • Atuar junto às áreas clientes para garantir alinhamento técnico e gerencial.

Accounting Specialist III

Apply locations South America/BRA/Sao Paulo - Aerospace time type Full time posted on Posted 3 Days Ago job requisition id R

We begin with dreams. Dreams drive our motivation. Dreams are our future. The world's dreams, people's dreams, our dreams. Our passion creates ideas that make dreams come alive. Technology and products that were only dreams become reality.


All for dreams. Dreams challenge and the Nidec-Group will continue to meet the challenge. For the world's and people's tomorrows; the world's first, the world's best technologies and products; we will continue our part in creating a better society.

Job Summary

Nidec is the world’s leading electric motor manufacturer and a true pioneer in electrification across a wide array of industries since its foundation in 1973, ranging from appliance, and energy infrastructure, to ground transportation. Nidec Aerospace is a newly created Joint Venture between Nidec and Embraer which intends to take a leading role in the Electrification of Aircrafts. We are well-positioned and excited to support the aerospace industry in its ambitious transition to net-zero carbon emissions by 2050.
The ideal candidate will embody Nidec’s key pillars of Passion, Enthusiasm, and Tenacity with their passion to learn, enthusiasm to exceed market expectations, and tenacity to solve complex technical issues. From ideation to production, you will work with a diverse and experienced team of design engineers to support aerospace industry leaders and spearhead technological advances in transport decarbonization.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-orientedAccounting Specialist III to join our team in São Paulo. This role is critical to maintaining the financial integrity of our organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting principles, both local and international (IFRS), and will be responsible for delivering accurate financial insight to support strategic decision-making.

Location: São José dos Campos - State of São Paulo, Brazil

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze financial data and prepare accurate, timely reports for management.

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards (IFRS and Brazilian GAAP).

  • Verify the accuracy of financial statements and related documentation.

  • Manage and reconcile accounts payable and receivable.

  • Maintain and oversee general ledger activities.

  • Support internal and external audits, including documentation and process improvements.

  • Assist in budget preparation, forecasting, and financial planning.

  • Provide financial analysis to support business decisions and strategic initiatives.

  • Ensure adherence to corporate financial policies and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant accounting experience.

  • CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade) certification preferred.

  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and Brazilian GAAP.

  • Proficiency in accounting systems; experience withSAP andBPC is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

  • Advanced English proficiency is required.

Additional Job Details

• Established professional; works under limited supervision
• Works independently on moderately complex projects/assignments and contributes to setting objectives or goals of projects and assignments within team

• Communicates with employees both within and occasionally outside of the department and/or job family on matters that require explanation, interpretation and/or advising; may communicate with external clients or partners depending upon the job area

About Us

Nidec has worked its way up to become the world's No.1 manufacturer of small precision motors. In the process, Nidec has gradually expanded its product lineup to include a variety of small to large motors, application products for machinery, and electronic and optical components.

At present, its products are used in a wide range of fields and devices including information and telecommunications equipment, office equipment, home appliances, automobiles, industrial equipment, and environmental energy.

Somos uma plataforma que empodera as empresas a criar experiências únicas de comunicação para seus clientes finais. Se você já interagiu com um chatbot, foi atendido por um canal de suporte em redes sociais ou fez uma compra por WhatsApp, nós estamos por trás da solução.

Em 2021, fomos a primeira empresa SaaS da América Latina a abrir capital na Nasdaq. Estamos atuando em diversos países na América Latina, com mais de 14 mil clientes. Somos GPTW e mais de 1200 Humanz trabalhando pelo mundo. A ZENVIA está crescendo rapidamente, e estamos sempre em busca de profissionais que tragam novas perspectivas. Nosso jeito de ser valoriza e respeita a individualidade de cada um, com autonomia para trabalhar e se desenvolver.

Por que estamos fazendo um banco de talentos exclusivo para pessoas com deficiência?

Este banco de talentos é destinado para pessoas com deficiência, pois queremos construir times cada vez mais fortes e um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo. A inclusão de pessoas com deficiência é uma de nossas prioridades. Essa é uma iniciativa que acreditamos e estamos muito felizes em realizar.

Na Zenvia acreditamos que a diversidade gera valor e trabalhamos de forma intencional para construir um ambiente que valorize nossas diferenças e um espaço no qual você se sinta seguro para ser quem você é.

Entendemos a importância de aumentar a representatividade de pessoas com deficiência na Zenvia e por isso queremos dar oportunidades de carreiras para as pessoas que queiram ser HUMANZ.

  • Nosso time analisa os currículos que chegam por aqui semanalmente e direcionam para as áreas que estamos recrutando.
  • Caso não haja uma vaga aberta para a área que você tem interesse, nosso time deixará seu currículo no banco de talentos e entrará em contato assim que tivermos uma posição que tenha aderência com o seu perfil.
  • Com o intuito de garantir maior equidade nos nossos processos de recrutamento, iremos priorizar a revisão dos currículos enviados através deste espaço para as posições que abrirmos na área de interesse sinalizada por você no momento da aplicação.
  • Pessoas com deficiência que se identifiquem com a Cultura da Zenvia e queiram fazer parte do nosso time;
  • Pessoas que estejam buscando um ambiente onde possam se desafiar e trabalhar com autonomia, responsabilidade e colaboração;
  • Pessoas curiosas, que buscam entender os problemas profundamente e buscam melhorias contínuas.
  • Pessoas que liderem a transformação e que não tenham medo de romper com o passado.
  • Pessoas que se desafiam e vão além. Que confie no seu potencial e se empodere pelo seu processo de crescimento e evolução.

O que nos faz um Great Place to Work?

  • Estamos 100% remotos e nosso horário de trabalho é flexível
  • Zenvia Care é nosso programa de benefícios para você e sua família
  • Healthcare: plano de saúde e odontológico, seguro de vida, telemedicina, especialidades médicas
  • Wellness care: day off no aniversário, Gympass, além de coach esportivo e nutricional e telepsicologia gratuito inclusive para dependentes
  • Parental care: licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, acompanhamento gestante e auxílio creche até 71 meses
  • Remote Care: política para quem quer se mudar temporariamente, R$1.500,00 para auxiliar nos equipamentos do seu escritório em casa, auxílio home office mensal de R$250,00, Alelo Tudo com Vale Refeição/Alimentação ou Benefícios flexíveis, e parceria com Woba para co-workings no Brasil inteiro

Team Overview

We're looking for a highly skilled and analytical CRM Data Analyst to join our team. This person will be responsible for supporting the design and execution of lifecycle journeys and communication strategies that support the growth of our business, ensuring users receive relevant, personalized, and timely communications. The person will be crucial in transforming our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data into actionable insights, driving smarter business decisions, boosting customer engagement, and optimizing our efforts.

Role Responsibilities

This role demands a strong blend of technical data analysis expertise, an understanding of customer journeys, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, concise insights for various stakeholders.

Main Responsibilities:

- Data Extraction & Analysis: Extract, clean, transform, and analyze large datasets from our databases. Your analysis will uncover trends and KPIs related to customer behavior, sales cycles, marketing campaign effectiveness, and customer service interactions.

- Reporting & Visualization: Develop and maintain comprehensive dashboards and reports using leading business intelligence tools. These visuals will provide clear, concise, and impactful insights to leadership and other relevant departments.

- Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor key CRM metrics and KPIs, proactively identifying areas for improvement and opportunities for growth.

- Data Quality & Integrity: Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of our CRM data through regular audits, data validation processes, and close collaboration with CRM administrators and users.

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with sales, marketing, customer service, and product teams to understand their data needs, offer dedicated analytical support, and translate business questions into analytical frameworks.

- Strategic Recommendations: Provide data-driven recommendations to optimize CRM processes, improve customer segmentation, personalize customer experiences, and enhance overall business performance.

Role Qualifications

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.

- Proven experience as a CRM Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a similar role with a strong focus on CRM data.

- Expert proficiency in SQL for complex data extraction and manipulation.

- Advanced skills in a business intelligence and data visualization tool such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable business insights.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of effectively conveying complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

- Familiarity with marketing automation platforms is a plus.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.

- Intermediate to advanced English is mandatory

description:
Overview

We are hiring an experienced IT System Administrator to help us scale, secure, and optimize our cloud infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in AWS, Terraform, and cloud automation, who also brings hands-on experience with services like Amazon FSx, Amazon WorkSpaces, and Amazon Q Business. You\'ll be a key contributor to infrastructure design, automation, monitoring, and Zero Trust security enforcement using tools like Spacelift, Zabbix, Zscaler, and Checkpoint CloudGuard.

Responsibilities, qualifications, and other details are described below.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and enhance AWS infrastructure, including core services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC) and enterprise solutions such as Amazon FSx (Windows file storage), Amazon WorkSpaces (virtual desktops), and Amazon Q Business (AI-powered knowledge search).
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform, orchestrating deployments and policy enforcement using Spacelift or equivalent.
  • Set up and manage monitoring solutions with Zabbix to ensure infrastructure performance and reliability.
  • Implement and support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) using Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) for secure remote access.
  • Enforce cloud security practices through Checkpoint CloudGuard, covering workload protection and compliance.
  • Experience with managing an IDP (Okta or equivalent) users, groups logic, and application integration.
  • Collaborate with development and IT teams to manage infrastructure code via GitHub, with a focus on stability, peer review, and traceability.
  • Automate routine processes and improve system efficiency through scripting (Bash, Python, or similar).

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing AWS infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong expertise in Terraform, with a track record of managing infrastructure via code.
  • Experience with Spacelift or equivalent tools for Terraform deployment pipelines.
  • Operational knowledge of Amazon FSx (especially Windows File Server), Amazon WorkSpaces.
  • Familiarity with Zabbix for infrastructure monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of Zscaler (ZTNA) or equivalent and Checkpoint CloudGuard or equivalent for security and access control.
  • Working knowledge of MDM solutions for Mac and Windows (Jamf, Endpoint Central or equivalent).
  • Skilled in using GitHub for code versioning, collaboration, and review workflows.
  • Competence in scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or similar languages.

What we offer

  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Truly competitive salary

title: Firmware Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Firmware Quality Assurance Analyst role at TRACTIAN.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What You\'ll Do

As a Firmware QA Analyst, you will take on the crucial responsibility of ensuring the quality, functionality, and reliability of our firmware products. You’ll serve as the last line of defense, protecting our customers from potential headaches and ensuring they experience only the best our technology has to offer. In this role, you will not only test and validate firmware but also champion a culture of continuous improvement across the organization. Your attention to detail and commitment to excellence will make you an advocate for firmware enhancements, driving our innovation forward. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact on the satisfaction of our customers and the success of our products.

Responsibilities

  • Building and Managing Test Environments: Design, implement, and maintain test environments to simulate real-world scenarios, ensuring thorough validation of firmware functionality and performance.
  • Developing and Automating Test Scripts: Create and maintain unit and automated test scripts to validate individual firmware modules and overall system behavior, ensuring comprehensive test coverage.
  • Documenting Testing Processes: Develop and maintain detailed documentation for test strategies, plans, cases, and methodologies, establishing clear and consistent testing guidelines across the team.
  • Integrating Testing into CI/CD Pipelines: Collaborate with the development team to embed automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline, enabling frequent and reliable testing for continuous delivery of high-quality firmware.
  • Ensuring Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with QA and development teams to identify and address testing gaps, improving processes and ensuring timely, high-quality releases.
  • Driving Firmware Quality Improvements: Act as a key stakeholder in the firmware lifecycle, advocating for quality-first approaches and ensuring the final product meets customer expectations and industry standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working with electronics or firmware engineering.
  • Familiarity with data acquisition, processing, and logging techniques for embedded testing purposes.
  • Understanding of data analysis methods and their application in firmware testing.
  • Proficiency with development tools such as VSCode and GitHub.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting languages, including Python and MATLAB.
  • Knowledge of embedded systems, with the ability to integrate modules and customize test equipment or environments.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.
  • Practical experience working with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, DAQs, multimeters, and power supplies.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with test implementations in a TDD or BDD environment.
  • Familiarity with C++ programming language.
  • Experience with firmware concepts, like RTOS, HAL, and other drivers.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, for CI/CD implementations.
  • Excellent analytical skills.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

Seniority level

  • Entry level

  • Full-time

Que tal tornar-se um(a) criador(a) do possível?

Há mais de 125 anos, estamos focados em nosso propósito, impulsionando o mundo da saúde. Comprometemo-nos incessantemente com um futuro promissor desenvolvendo tecnologias, serviços e soluções inovadoras, ajudando a comunidade de saúde a melhorar a segurança e aumentar a eficiência. É preciso a criatividade e a paixão de todos nós na BD, desde a manufatura até o marketing, da fabricação até a comercialização de nossos produtos, para olhar para o impossível e encontrar soluções transformadoras que tornem sonhos em possibilidades - para as pessoas hoje, amanhã e sempre. Torne-se um(a) criador(a) do possível conosco!

A BD Biosciences (BDB) é líder em soluções de citometria de fluxo e genômica de célula única, pesquisa científica e laboratórios clínicos de alta qualidade. Estamos liderando o caminho ao desenvolver as melhores tecnologias para olhar mais de perto os detalhes de células e patologias.

A pessoa Especialista Aplicação em Campo Jr é responsável por implementar novas tecnologias, treinar clientes, participar de etapas de pré/pós-venda, desenvolver materiais científicos e ministrar palestras em congressos como especialista técnico. Identificar e desenvolver as oportunidades de negócios por meio de análises de dados e suporte ciêntifico com foco em geração de demanda.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Contribuir para atingir as metas do negócio através do suporte científico aos clientes e à equipe de vendas;
  • Prover respostas assertivas e realizar o acompanhamento de chamados abertos por meio de todos os canais de atendimento disponíveis;
  • Assegurar a máxima utilização dos equipamentos e reagentes através de treinamentos e/ou visitas periódicas;
  • Utilizar sistemas internos da BD para gerenciamento de documentos e atividades (ServiceMax, Veeva, Pipefy, Portal do cliente, SalesForce, etc);
  • Formular apresentações, manuais e outros materiais voltados à educação técnico-científica dos clientes;
  • Contribuir com projetos que visam implementação de novas tecnologias/ novos produtos por meio de palestras e visitas técnicas;
  • Colaborar com a identificação dos principais projetos de pesquisa científica do país e criar plano de visitação a clientes estratégicos;
  • Planejamento, frequência e sequência no plano de visitação aos grupos mapeados;
  • Executar estratégias de geração de demanda para incremento de vendas alinhadas com as estratégias de negócios, provendo inteligência competitiva e de mercado para outros membros da equipe;
  • Construir relacionamentos fortes e posicionar a proposta de valor de BDB com tomadores de decisão de nível sênior, influenciadores importantes e KOL em contas existentes e novas por meio de uma abordagem baseada em valor com atingimento dos objetivos de vendas.

Requisitos:

  • Escolaridade desejável: Pós-Graduação
  • É indispensável experiência com citometria de fluxo em pesquisa.
  • Idiomas obrigatórios: Inglês avançado
  • Idiomas desejáveis: Espanhol

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Quality Engineer role at TRACTIAN .

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

What You'll Do

As a Quality Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of the materials used in our products. Your expertise will contribute significantly to our mission of delivering exceptional IIoT solutions to industries worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the design and manufacturing teams to define quality standards, specifications, and inspection criteria for mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Conduct thorough quality assessments of incoming materials, ensuring they meet specified requirements and are free from defects.
  • Develop and implement quality control processes, including inspection plans, testing procedures, and relevant documentation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for any quality issues identified during testing or production, and track these actions to closure.
  • Participate in the design review process to provide insights on potential quality concerns and ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA).
  • Conduct regular audits of manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve component quality, resolve quality-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in the supply chain.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of quality assurance activities, including test results, inspection reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality documentation, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, and quality manuals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Quality Engineer, preferably in a manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity in quality tools, methodologies and documentation such as 8D, DMAIC, NCR, EA and statistical process control.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Reading and Writing English proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Experience with plastic injection and mold manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Reliability Engineering and its tools.
  • Spanish proficiency.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

Implementar e configurar o Salesforce Marketing Cloud e seus módulos, garantindo a integração com os demais sistemas.

Diferenciais

Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.

A JDE Peet’s é uma empresa líder mundial especializada em cafés e chás, sediada na Holanda e com uma história que começou em 1753. Despertamos possibilidades de café e chá em mais de 100 países com um portfólio de mais de 50 marcas, incluindo L’OR, Peet’s, Jacobs, Senseo, Tassimo, Douwe Egberts, OldTown, Super, Pickwick e Moccona.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional com liderança absoluta em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de café e chá. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar um impacto positivo no mundo do café e do chá.
Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá.
Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.

title: Volunteer System Manager
description:
Volunteer System Manager

Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). The Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model. This role leads the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform while overseeing essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT, and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset.
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification desired.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level | Employment type: Contract | Job function: Information Technology.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (LATAM)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Front End Developer (LATAM) role at Lateral Group

Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality. Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral Our mission is simple: design and build great products . What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work . We have a bias for action and results. We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results speak for themselves. We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality – Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to. We Care Deeply . We care about our work and about each other. Care is a competitive advantage. Every detail matters – every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default. We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do . Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way. We Keep Improving . The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection. We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto . We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around. We Take Ownership . Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Front End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality.
  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.
  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.
  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale and writing tests to prevent regressions.
  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. Stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience. You’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.

Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. You might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow.
  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.
  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How We Measure Success In This Role

In the first two weeks: You\'ve set up your development environment and tools. You\'ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature). You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style. You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project\'s context.

In the first 3 months: You\’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative. You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation. You\’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents. You\’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance. You\’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months: You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team. You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard). You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks. You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through: The impact and scope of your technical contributions. Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices. Code quality, performance, and maintainability. Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership. Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.
  • Proven ability to craft, polish, delight, sweat the details. You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.
  • Quality and reliability: You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments. Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.
  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.
  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about being kind, open, and constructive, so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.
  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft
  • Design /delight sensibility
  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling
  • Understanding Backend concepts
  • CSR/SSR
  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.
  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
  • We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.
  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.
  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace.
  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.
  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.
  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.
  • Feedback doesn\'t excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.
  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time. We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is
  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible
  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

If this sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us:

  • A brief note telling us what excites you about this role
  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work — Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft
  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special
  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary
  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of. We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral\'s values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.
  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.
  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics
  • Motivators and demotivators.
  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.
  • Be ready to discuss challenges you\'ve overcome and lessons learned.
  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral\'s mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.
  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.
  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.

Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you\'d encounter in the position.
  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.
  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.
  • How you collaborate across disciplines.
  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.
  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.
  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: We’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you\'ve mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do this when we feel we need more context. We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out to due to confidentiality or other reasons. And here’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room.” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you\'ll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information. Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.
